newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends weaker vs dlr,stable vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends weaker vs dlr,stable vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a shade weaker against the dollar as the US unit recovered against the mark, but remained steady against the central bank's currency basket in average turnover, dealers said.
The forint finished at 185.40/45 to the dollar, compared with 185.00/05 at opening, and remained stuck at the central bank's resistance level.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
